name: Sacred Flame
summary: A cantrip that calls down flame-like radiance for Radiant damage, ignoring cover.

stats.effect: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for this save.
stats.cantripUpgrade: The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).
